<?php
function warning178($severity178, $message178) {
    global $mode178, $source178, $left178, $right178, $warnings178;
    ++$warnings178;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings178, ':', $message178, '|';
    if ($mode178 === 1) { $source178 = 41; }
    else {
        if ($warnings178 === 1) { $left178 = 41; $right178 = 3.5; }
        else { $left178 = 4.5; $right178 = 44; }
    }
    return true;
}
function receive178(int &$first178, int &$second178) {
    echo 'body:', $first178, ':', $second178, '|';
    return $second178;
}
set_error_handler('warning178');
$mode178 = 1;
$source178 = 1.5;
$warnings178 = 0;
$got178 = receive178($source178, $source178);
echo 'same:', $got178, ':', $source178, '|';
$mode178 = 2;
$left178 = 1.5;
$right178 = 2.5;
$warnings178 = 0;
$got178 = receive178($left178, $right178);
echo 'distinct:', $got178, ':', $left178, ':', $right178, '|';
$left178 = 1.5;
$right178 = 2.5;
$warnings178 = 0;
receive178($left178, $right178);
echo 'ignored:', $left178, ':', $right178, '|';
purpose: The same ordinary CV sent twice aliases one cell and warns once. Distinct references read the later handler-mutated3.5 at its own RECV; the second handler changes the earlier verified int formal to4.5 without a prior-type recheck.

<?php
function warning178($severity178, $message178) {
    global $left178, $right178, $warnings178, $original178;
    ++$warnings178;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings178, ':', $message178, '|';
    if ($warnings178 === 1) { $left178 = 41; $right178 = 3.5; return true; }
    $left178 = 4.5;
    $right178 = 44;
    throw $original178;
}
function receive178(int &$first178, int &$second178) {
    echo 'body|';
    return $second178;
}
$original178 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning178');
$left178 = 1.5;
$right178 = 2.5;
$warnings178 = 0;
$destination178 = 91;
try { $destination178 = receive178($left178, $right178); }
catch (Throwable $caught178) {
    echo 'caught:', (int)($caught178 === $original178), ':', (int)($caught178->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination178, ':', $left178, ':', $right178, '|';
}
purpose: The second precision handler throws the original Exception after rewriting the already verified first reference to4.5 and selected second reference to44. Both writes survive, with no body/result assignment or replacement TypeError/Previous.
expected_normal_stdout: warning:1:Implicit conversion from float 1.5 to int loses precision|warning:2:Implicit conversion from float 3.5 to int loses precision|caught:1:1:91:4.5:44|

<?php
function warning178($severity178, $message178) {
    global $source178, $throw178, $original178;
    echo 'warning:', $message178, '|';
    $source178 = 41;
    if ($throw178) { throw $original178; }
    return true;
}
function receive178(int &$first178, int &$second178) {
    echo 'body|';
    return $first178 + $second178;
}
$original178 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning178');
$source178 = 1.5;
$throw178 = false;
$destination178 = 91;
try { $destination178 = receive178($source178); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught178) { echo 'missing:', $destination178, ':', $source178, '|'; }
$source178 = 1.5;
$throw178 = true;
try { $destination178 = receive178($source178); }
catch (Throwable $caught178) {
    echo 'caught:', (int)($caught178 === $original178), ':', (int)($caught178->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination178, ':', $source178, '|';
}
purpose: A completed first by-reference precision conversion writes saved1 before a later missing-argument error. A throwing handler instead leaves its current41 and original Exception before that missing receive.
